|game_text=If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-18-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012, slip 00; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 4, slip 18 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34, page 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 (this page); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata 3)]], the same words). The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) drops “from here” in the last sentence and writes “Son of Vader” (three times) and “Rebel Starships”. PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1281_18">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel Starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son of Vader as if from hand.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side]]) again, word for word: “If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-18-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-giveyourselftothedarkside-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Give Yourself To The Dark Side]]) again, word for word: “If [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place{{!}}Bring Him Before Me]] on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. '''A Powerful Ally:''' While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
